title: LLMs Can Get "Brain Rot": A Pilot Study on Twitter/X
abstract: arXiv:2510.13928v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose and test the LLM Brain Rot Hypothesis: continual exposure to junk web text induces lasting cognitive decline in large language models (LLMs). To unveil junk effects, we designed a novel controlled experiment on real Twitter/X corpora, by constructing junk and reverse-controlled datasets via two orthogonal operationalizations: M1 (engagement degree) and M2 (semantic quality), with matched token scale and training operations across conditions. Compared to the control group, continual pre-training of 4 LLMs on the junk dataset causes non-trivial declines (Hedges' g>0.3) on reasoning, long-context understanding, safety, and inflating "dark traits" (e.g., psychopathy, narcissism). The gradual mixtures of junk and control datasets also yield dose-response cognition decay: for example, under M1, ARC-Challenge with Chain-of-Thought drops 72.1 -> 57.2 and RULER-CWE 83.7 -> 52.3 as junk ratio rises from 0% to 100%. translated_title: 大语言模型也会“脑腐化”：一项基于Twitter/X的初步研究
translated_abstract: 我们提出并验证了“大语言模型脑腐化假说”：持续暴露于垃圾网络文本会导致大语言模型（LLM）产生持久的认知衰退。为了揭示垃圾文本的影响，我们在真实的Twitter/X语料库上设计了一项新颖的对照实验，通过两种正交的操作化方式构建了垃圾数据集和反向对照数据集：M1（互动参与度）和M2（语义质量），并确保各条件下token规模和训练操作完全一致。与对照组相比，4个大语言模型在垃圾数据集上进行持续预训练后，在推理、长上下文理解和安全性方面出现了显著下降（Hedges' g>0.3），同时“黑暗人格特质”（如精神变态、自恋）有所膨胀。垃圾数据集与对照数据集的渐进混合还产生了剂量-反应式的认知衰退：例如，在M1条件下，随着垃圾数据比例从0%升至100%，采用思维链的ARC-Challenge得分从72.1降至57.2，RULER-CWE从83.7降至52.3。错误取证分析…
tldr: 本研究首次提出并通过Twitter/X真实语料的对照实验验证了“LLM脑腐化假说”，证明持续预训练低质量垃圾网络文本会导致大语言模型在推理、长上下文理解和安全性上出现类似剂量-反应关系的持久认知衰退。
